decision_record_2a.transfer: Overnight-return harvesters pay the closing spread for immediacy at 15:30 ET; this sleeve crossed the full ask on entry and full bid at the next open for a 25bp-class, ~18h edge — spread paid twice can exceed expected capture.
decision_record_2a.comparison: Paired shadow control on the same opportunity: control_price = quoted ask the pre-change market order would have paid; treatment = entry limit at the quoted bid/ask mid.
decision_record_2a.mechanism: Execution / spread capture at entry (the binding crossing; exit stays the pre-change scheduled open exit, named as the next leak candidate). Sizing, signal (12:30->14:30 return >= p80 of 126+ sessions), window 15:30-15:35 ET unchanged.
decision_record_2a.calculation: saved_per_share = ask - mid = spread/2, recorded per intent in enhance_exp.spread_saved; uplift = sum over filled paired records minus non-fill opportunity cost.
decision_record_2a.experiment: Forward paper: paired records journaled for every treated entry. Reject if mid-limit fill rate < 80% of control-window entries over 20 paired opportunities, or mean spread_saved <= 0. Switch OFF restores the market order exactly (blocker-proven).

shadow_control: never emits; control price recorded on the treated intent only
